subject: Final decision checkpoint: MAP close & day-zero cadence

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Final decision checkpoint: MAP close & day-zero cadence

Hi Siu-Lee,

Thanks again for the productive MAP review yesterday. I pulled together a short final checkpoint so we can lock the sign schedule and first-day cadence. Attached: MAP-Velocity-v3.xlsx (single-sheet mutual action plan) and SLA-Draft-Velocity.pdf (SLA + uptime appendix).

Key asks for your team:
- Confirm authorized signer and their available signing window between Sep 20–Oct 2.
- Confirm target production start date (Velocity suggested Oct 4 on the call). If you need a phased ramp, indicate Day 0 vs Day 7 scope.
- Any legal redlines that require more than 5 business days to resolve? If so, please flag the clauses and we’ll prioritize.

Our suggested cadence if we get a clean sign by Sep 30:
1) Sep 30–Oct 1: Signature and countersign
2) Oct 2–3: Provisioning and staging handoff (engineering)
3) Oct 4: Day 0 — soft launch (limited traffic)

If procurement needs a PO in addition to signature, let me know the PO number format; we can accept PO on the same day as signature for billing start.

I copied Camila for onboarding logistics and Kimberly for legal redline triage. Can we schedule a 15-min sync on Aug 28 to confirm the signer window? I’m available 11:00–12:30 PT.

Thanks,
Rafael
--
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Rafael —

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. Quick answers from procurement side:
- Authorized signer will be Alan Chu (SVP, Engineering). Alan is available for e-sign between Sep 23–Sep 29 (AM PT preferred) or Oct 1 (anytime).
- Target start: Oct 4 still works as our preferred Day 0 target. We will plan a 2-week ramp (Day 0 limited to internal traffic, Day 7 wider rollout).
- Legal: I forwarded SLA-Draft to our legal counsel. We expect 2–4 business days for routine redlines, except one data-retention clause they flagged that may need a short discussion. I’ll send the redline pdf by EOD Aug 28 if possible.

Procurement also asked: will Redwood accept a PO + e-sign combo? If so, we will issue a PO on the day of signature and mark billing to start on Oct 4.

Let’s lock a 15-min sync tomorrow Aug 28 at 11:30 PT to confirm Alan’s window.

Best,
Siu-Lee
Director, IT Programs
Velocity Retail

Date: 2026-08-27T16:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final decision checkpoint: MAP close & day-zero cadence

Team —

I reviewed SLA-Draft-Velocity.pdf quickly and pulled out two items to flag for the call:
1) Data retention / exportability (Section 4.3): their counsel added a request to retain logs for 36 months. Our default is 24 months for hosted customers; we can offer 36 months as a paid add-on or discuss a contract-level exception.
2) Incident notification windows (Section 6): they requested 1-hour notify for Sev1. Our standard is 2 hours without an SLA uplift. We can include a 1-hour notify and tiered credits if they need a guarantee — will need ops input and an SLA amendment.

Suggested play for the sync: Rafael to confirm signer window and PO flow, Camila to describe provisioning timeline, Kimberly to propose options for retention and Sev1 notify (quick bullets). If Velocity needs the 36-month retention baked in, ask procurement whether that is a hard blocker vs a commercial uplift.

I can turn around redline suggestions for the two clauses by EOD Aug 28 and be on the sync.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Siu-Lee / Alan —

Great, thanks for the quick replies and for confirming Alan as signer. We’re locked for the 11:30 PT sync today — I’ll send a calendar invite in the next 10 minutes.

Short recap of agreed items in prep for the sync:
- Signing window: Sep 23–29 (AM PT preferred). If Alan confirms Sep 23 or Sep 24 we will prioritize that slot for e-sign and countersign on the same day.
- PO flow: Redwood accepts PO issued the same day as signature (please include vendor code RWINF-0057). Billing will start on the agreed production start (Oct 4).
- Legal open items: Kimberly will send redline bullets for retention and Sev1 notify by EOD Aug 28; Velocity legal to return any additional redlines by Sep 3 to preserve the timeline.
- Onboarding: Camila will draft the Day 0 runbook and share a short checklist during the sync.

If all goes as planned on signatures and procurement we will keep Oct 4 as the Day 0 kickoff. If legal needs more time we’ll propose a contingency start on Oct 11.

Call invite: 15 min — Aug 28, 11:30–11:45 PT (Zoom link in calendar invite).

Thanks everyone — looking forward to wrapping this up.

Rafael
